english.title: Cause death by driving whilst disqualified
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused the death of **(..SPECIFY NAME OF DECEASED AND DATE OF DEATH IF DIFFERENT FROM DATE OF DRIVING..) by driving a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), and, at that time, you were committing an offence under section 103(1)(b) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 by driving when you were disqualified from holding or obtaining a driving licence to drive a motor vehicle of that class
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3ZC of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
